adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff replaces `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)` and removes the subsequent `if (!tokenResponse.success) { console.error(..., responseJson) }` block. The new helper (`parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`) throws on parse failure (`if (!refreshTokenResponse.success) throw new Error(...)`), so a previously logged-but-continued path becomes an exception path, and the MS response is no longer logged. This is a real, diff-grounded change in error-handling/diagnostics, but it’s not clearly a correctness defect since failing fast on invalid token refresh can be intended behavior.
